text: [PART D. INSURED DECLARED VALUE (IDV)] A claim will be settled as Total Loss if the cost of repair exceeds 75% of IDV.

heading: PART E. DEDUCTIBLE
text: PART E. DEDUCTIBLE You are responsible for the first Rs. 2,000 of each own damage claim under Part A of this policy. This compulsory excess applies per occurrence. An optional voluntary excess of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, or Rs. 5,000 may be selected at inception for a premium discount.

text: PART G. HOW TO MAKE A CLAIM (cid:127) Contact our 24-hour claims helpline within 24 hours of the incident. (cid:127) Do not authorise repairs above Rs. 500 without our written approval. (cid:127) Submit your claim form, vehicle documents, and repair estimate within 7 days.

heading: PART H. GENERAL EXCEPTIONS
text: PART H. GENERAL EXCEPTIONS This policy does not cover any loss arising from: war, nuclear risk, use of vehicle in violation of permit conditions, driving without a valid licence, or use of the vehicle outside the permitted geographical area.
